exposure: Uterine necrosis (caused by infection in this case)
cohort: A 28-year-old woman with uterine necrosis following a cesarean section.
finding: Minimally invasive treatment, including laparoscopic removal of necrotic tissue and antibiotic therapy, was successful in managing uterine necrosis and preserving the patient's uterus and reproductive function.
mod_finding: The patient underwent a cesarean section prior to developing uterine necrosis.
